o: Lucy Albright and Stephen DeMarco return to college, not speaking after their dramatic breakup at the start of the summer. Yet while very much at odds, they find themselves in a new version of their addictive dynamic - which is as infuriating as it is inescapable.

eps.t: You Got a Reaction, Didn't You?
eps.o: Lucy's back at Baird College for sophomore year, ready to start fresh and leave past mistakes behind her.

eps.t: I Shall Now Perform a 180 Flip-Flop
eps.o: Bree's birthday takes an unexpected turn. Lucy's excited to focus on someone new.

eps.t: I Can See Right Through Myself
eps.o: Stephen baits Lucy as she attempts to rid herself of him once and for all. Wrigley and Pippa finally talk.
As the LSAT looms, Stephen's anxiety grows. Wrigley and Evan have a guy's night out.
Lydia and Stephen's sister, Sadie, both visit campus for Halloween. Lucy and Pippa learn something unsettling.

eps.t: Do Your Dirty Words Come Out to Play?
eps.o: When a snowed-in campus forces everyone to Evan's for Thanksgiving, tensions run high.
Lucy and Bree attend a professor's Christmas party. Lucy makes a rash decision that affects Pippa.

eps.t: Don't Struggle Like That, or I Will Only Love You More
eps.o: End of semester Christmas celebrations change everything for everyone – again.
